summary: Removes the allowlist check on the webhook target URL, enabling SSRF by allowing requests to internal infrastructure.

findings.message: The host allowlist guard is removed; an attacker can supply any URL (e.g. http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/) causing the server to make requests to internal services.
findings.suggestion: Restore the allowlist check before calling httpx.post, and ensure the parsed hostname is compared after resolving any redirects.
